Hi Sofia — looping in a quick note from the contracts side. Thanks for sending your internal notes. I reviewed the three flagged clauses and here are concise positions we can take to keep the deal moving: 

1) Data retention window (Clause 4.3) — propose a 90-day K/V cache plus customer-configurable retention; provide SOC 2 audit extract.
2) Liability cap (Clause 7.1) — open to capping at 2x annualized committed spend for a limited set of incidents; exclude consequential damages where possible.
3) Audit access & logs (Clause 5.2) — can provide time-bound access via redwood audit export; we need to align on frequency/format.

I've attached an updated tracked-changes file (Novus_Redlines_v2.docx) with inline comments where we plan to concede vs. recommend alternate language. Also included a short SOC2_summary.pdf that documents the type-2 scope relevant to this deployment.

If procurement wants to triage only the high-impact items, Karthik and I can run the 30-min slot on Tue Nov 23 at 10:00 PT. For the full legal team, Wed Nov 24 13:00 PT works from our side — please confirm the attendee list and I'll formalise the invite.
